params.model: dS = mu S dt + sigma S dW (drift first), stepped exactly: S_{i+1} = S_i exp((mu - 1/2 sigma^2) dt + sigma dW_i); call priced and hedged at sigma_implied from the closed form (2.9) as a black box
params.hedge: buy one call at V_0, short Delta shares, cash at r; rebalance N times on an even grid; P&L reported at T (pnl_T) and discounted to 0 (pnl_discounted)
